scraped.title: Job partnership and SME promotion
scraped.subtitle: CPE of the project “Job partnership and SME promotion in Rwanda”

body: Subject to this evaluation was the project “Job partnership and SME promotion in Rwanda” with an overall term from 01.06.2019 – 30.04.2027 and a commissioning value of 41,390,000 EUR. The German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) has put together a package of measures to support local and international companies in investment activities that have a high employment impact in its African partner countries. The special initiative’s objective is to team up with companies to create good jobs and improve working conditions and social protection in eight African partner countries, including Rwanda. Its five core outputs in Rwanda were:
1. Improvement of the conditions for investments by African and international companies
2. Improvement of the capacities of small and medium-sized enterprises with growth potential
3. Strengthening of the corporate ecosystem in selected clusters (industrial zones)
4. Support to companies to mitigate the economic consequences of the Covid-19 pandemic in terms of job preservation
5. Strengthening of the ecosystem in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector

ICON was commissioned to conduct the central project evaluation (CPE) for the project. The evaluation considered all OECD DAC criteria and foresaw a remote inception and in-person evaluation mission. The methodology included:
contribution analysis with revision of the results model
remote and in-person key informant interviews as well as focus group discussions and desk review
efficiency analysis with follow the money approach
multi-stakeholder perspectives from beneficiaries, partners, staff to experts and public informants
rigorous triangulation across informants, type of source and evaluator
